note: Return assumptions for the Wealth Projector. VERIFY against tsp.gov/fund-performance before annual updates. Long-run figures are index-backfilled compound annual returns since April 1987 (C/S/I funds began later; earlier years use their underlying index). All figures are nominal, before inflation. Past performance does not predict future returns — every figure is editable in the UI.

otherAssets.sp500Note: Approximate long-run compound annual return of the S&P 500 with dividends reinvested (1926-2025), nominal. Editable.
otherAssets.savingsNote: Typical high-yield savings APY as of early 2026. Rates move with the Fed - use your bank's rate.
otherAssets.inflationNote: Long-run planning assumption; the Federal Reserve targets 2%.
